description: Search Certificate Transparency logs for a domain's certificates, and follow the stream of new issuances.

api.description: Read the continuous stream of new issuances across every log; requires a Firehose subscription and a cursor to continue from

fields.description: Return issuances discovered after this ID; omit to start from about an hour ago

fields.type: (dns_names | issuer | issuer.website | issuer.caa_domains | issuer.operator | issuer.pubkey_der | issuer.name_der | pubkey | pubkey_der | revocation | problem_reporting | cert_der)[]

api.description: List the unexpired certificate issuances for a domain, newest last, with an `after` cursor for paging

fields.description: Registered domain or a name under it, e.g. "example.com" or "www.example.com"; a bare TLD is rejected
Also return issuances valid for sub-domains; default false
Also return wildcard matches, e.g. *.example.com; default false
Return issuances discovered after this ID; take `id` from the last result of the previous page

fields.type: (dns_names | issuer | issuer.website | issuer.caa_domains | issuer.operator | issuer.pubkey_der | issuer.name_der | pubkey | pubkey_der | revocation | problem_reporting | cert_der)[]
fields.description: Extra fields to include; repeated as one `expand` per value
